name: serial-build
description: Build a product one demonstrable gate at a time: an interview that scaffolds the project, a gate ledger (roadmap, plan, done with proof), plan-mode gate planning with an adversarial reviewer, intake that never edits the docs ad hoc, a red lane that tries to break every gate before it ships, and a handoff that re-runs every proof. Hooks guard generated files, lint on edit, test at stop, and keep an inbox empty, and all of them do nothing in a project without .claude/serial-build.json.
